_comment: THREE-WAY LOCKSTEP fixture for the mirror scene-delta static-kept field set. A field here is carried forward from the retained node on a volatile-only upsert (client mergeNode keeps it from `existing`; server MergeVolatile keeps it from `existing`; server ToVolatile NULLS it so the projection drops it and the client refills it). Drift on ANY of the three sides breaks a test: CouchCoopSceneObserverTests (C#, MergeVolatile + ToVolatile) and staticFields.spec.ts (vitest, mergeNode). Field names are the WIRE (serialized camelCase) names; the vitest maps a few to their client shapes (see clientFieldNotes). This set is single-sourced from the client mergeNode keep-list, which is the agreed contract; the server ToVolatile restores the two producer-VOLATILE fields MergeVolatile over-keeps (see volatileOutlineFields).
_stickyComment: STICKY fields are a THIRD category, distinct from wireStaticFields: the producer re-ships them only when their own value changed (not on every tick, and not only on add/keyframe), so BOTH merges use `upsert ?? existing` — a null upsert value means 'unchanged, keep yours' and a non-null one REPLACES. Because they can legitimately arrive on a volatile-only upsert, the server's ToVolatile gates them on a per-window dirty flag (intentDirty / lineDirty) instead of nulling them unconditionally. `intentFrames` is the enemy-intent glyph frame set; `linePoints`/`lineWidth`/`lineColor` are the Line2D map-quill stroke unit and ship together. Both legs (StaticFieldsTests.cs, staticFields.spec.ts) iterate this list, so adding a sticky field without a check fails.

clientFieldNotes.font: font object bundles fontWeight + fontStyle (client folds the two weight/style wire fields into the font object)
clientFieldNotes.richBoldFont: richBoldFont object (same resolved shape as font, but no weight/style — the FILE is the role); italic/bold-italic symmetric
clientFieldNotes.richBoldFontSizePx: absolute px, present only when the role size differs from the node's normal size; the client consumes it as a RATIO
